svg.title: Fleet: dashcam event to driver coaching
svg.desc: Vehicle edge: a telematics trigger makes the dash camera save an event clip, which is uploaded and scored by an AI triage service and stored. A severe event alerts the dispatcher, who makes a welfare check with the driver. A safety reviewer reviews stored events; non-coachable events are dismissed. Coachable events are assigned to the fleet manager, who schedules a coaching session with the driver and records the outcome.
svg.text: Fleet: dashcam event to driver coaching
A triggered video event is uploaded and scored; severe events alert a dispatcher, coachable events go to a safety review and a coaching session.
Illustrative, generic workflow. Lanes are roles; thresholds and timings are examples. Generic symbols do not assert product capabilities.
